name: Angel Gonzalez
source: Angel is a crude, hot headed girl who is always trying to find the next big music project to work on. Her destiny, she believes, is to perform on the stage, but she typically spends her time playing video games or collecting CDs. Despite her usually mean demanor, she has a soft side only shown to a few where she's loyal and protective over her friends and loved ones, particularly her childhood friend, Sidney. Coming closest to knowing Angel's true personality, Sidney is her sage space and one true friend with the two often spending long nights reminiscing on their past or talking about the future.
